newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Noble Group Singapore IPO subscribed 18.8 times.
newsitem.headline: Noble Group Singapore IPO subscribed 18.8 times.

text.p: Asian commodity company Noble Group Ltd initial public offer (IPO) shares available to the general public were subscribed 18.8 times, United Overseas Bank (UOB) announced on Wednesday, according to a Noble statement.

Noble offered 51.49 million shares at US$0.88 each in its IPO. Of this total, 41.19 million were sold by placement and 4.21 million shares taken up by employeees and associates, leaving 6.09 million shares available to the general public.
Founded in 1986, Hong Kong-based Noble sources, transports, finances and delivers a range of commodities from primary producers to processors and end-users.

The IPO is expected to raise a net $39.4 million, of which approximately $10 million will be used to expand the group's range of products and $10 million to acquire vessels to expand its shipping business. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
